newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 3.73 million barrels in the week ended Jan 24 to 289.77 million barrels from 286.04 million barrels the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 4.56 million barrels in the week to 227.27 million barrels.
Distillate stocks fell 2.85 million barrels to 119.64 million from 122.50 million the previous week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks fell 1.91 million barrels to 43.89 million barrels.
API said gasoline production fell 16,000 barrels in the week to 7.36 million bpd from 7.38 million.
Gasoline stocks rose 1.84 million barrels in the week to 201.30 million barrels from 199.45 million barrels.
Percent of stocks capacity fell to 89.1 percent from 89.9 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 2.05 million barrels to 40.59 million barrels from 38.54 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units fell to 13.54 million barrels from 13.63 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 43.89 million barrels from 44.07 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports rose to 7.84 million barrels per day from 7.02 million, API said.
